name: nestjs-microservices-monorepo
description: NestJS microservices example with gRPC, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL

scripts.start:dev: concurrently "npm run start:dev --prefix services/auth-service" "npm run start:dev --prefix services/product-service" "npm run start:dev --prefix services/order-service"
scripts.prisma:generate: cd services/product-service && npx prisma generate && cd ../order-service && npx prisma generate
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd services/product-service && npx prisma migrate deploy && cd ../order-service && npx prisma migrate deploy
